My test expectations were wrong, not the bridge. Let me fix my tests:

- 'fin-order': I wrote `rec(12, ..., length=len(exp))` but s12 has no x-a field so length differs. Fix.
- 'terminal-states': sid 8 in that test uses `stream(8, base_fields())` which includes terminal='fin' → forwarded. My expectation of incomplete was wrong. Let me change the test to use a headers-only stream without fin.

Let me rewrite the tests more carefully.

cat > /workspace/tmp/t1.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

ROUTES = {'https://demo.test': 'r1', 'http://a.test': 'r2',
          'http://a.test:8080': 'r3', 'https://[2001:db8::1]': 'r4',
          'http://10.0.0.1': 'r5'}
EMPTY = {k: b'' for k in ROUTES.values()}

check('empty', {'routes': {}, 'events': []}, [], {})
check('unused-origin', {'routes': {'https://demo.test': 'u'}, 'events': []}, [], {'u': b''})

ev = stream(0, base_fields())
want = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n'
check('basic-get', {'routes': ROUTES, 'events': ev},
      [rec(0, 'forwarded', commit_at=1, origin='r1', offset=0, length=len(want),
           cache_key=['GET', 'https', 'demo.test', '/'])],
      dict(EMPTY, r1=want))

# sid sorting + origin offsets in FIN order
ev = (stream(8, base_fields(path='/s8', extra=[('x-a', '1')]))
      + stream(4, base_fields(path='/s4', authority='a.test', scheme='http'))
      + stream(12, base_fields(path='/s12')))
exp8 = b'GET /s8 HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\nx-a: 1\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n'
exp4 = b'GET /s4 HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: a.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n'
exp12 = b'GET /s12 HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n'
check('fin-order', {'routes': ROUTES, 'events': ev},
      [rec(4, 'forwarded', commit_at=3, origin='r2', offset=0, length=len(exp4), cache_key=['GET','http','a.test','/s4']),
       rec(8, 'forwarded', commit_at=1, origin='r1', offset=0, length=len(exp8), cache_key=['GET','https','demo.test','/s8']),
       rec(12, 'forwarded', commit_at=5, origin='r1', offset=len(exp8), length=len(exp12), cache_key=['GET','https','demo.test','/s12'])],
      dict(EMPTY, r1=exp8+exp12, r2=exp4))

# cancelled / incomplete / rejected nulls
ev = (stream(0, base_fields(), terminal='reset')
      + stream(4, base_fields(extra=[('bad', 'a\rb')]))
      + [{'sid': 8, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': base_fields()}])
check('terminal-states', {'routes': ROUTES, 'events': ev},
      [rec(0, 'cancelled'), rec(4, 'rejected'), rec(8, 'incomplete')], EMPTY)

# unknown frames ignored everywhere
ev = ([{'sid': 0, 'type': 'unknown', 'frame_type': 33, 'hex': 'aa'}]
      + stream(0, fields=base_fields(path='/u'), data=['0102'],
               trailing=[['x-audit-t', 'v']])
      + [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'unknown', 'frame_type': 64, 'hex': '0000'}])
want = (b'GET /u HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\r\n'
        b'trailer: x-audit-t\r\n\r\n2\r\n' + b'\x01\x02' + b'\r\n0\r\nx-audit-t: v\r\n\r\n')
check('unknown-ignored', {'routes': ROUTES, 'events': ev},
      [rec(0, 'forwarded', commit_at=6, origin='r1', offset=0, length=len(want), cache_key=['GET','https','demo.test','/u'])],
      dict(EMPTY, r1=want))

for nm, ev in [
    ('data-first', [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'data', 'hex': '00'}, {'sid': 0, 'type': 'fin'}]),
    ('fin-only', [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'fin'}]),
    ('unknown-then-fin', [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'unknown', 'frame_type': 7, 'hex': ''}, {'sid': 0, 'type': 'fin'}]),
    ('reset-first', [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'reset'}]),
    ('third-headers', [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': base_fields()},
                       {'sid': 0, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': []},
                       {'sid': 0, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': []},
                       {'sid': 0, 'type': 'fin'}]),
    ('data-after-trailer', [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': base_fields()},
                            {'sid': 0, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': []},
                            {'sid': 0, 'type': 'data', 'hex': '00'},
                            {'sid': 0, 'type': 'fin'}]),
]:
    check(nm, {'routes': ROUTES, 'events': ev}, [rec(0, 'rejected' if 'reset' not in nm else 'cancelled')], EMPTY)
